Numericals use changed amounts with the chapter's own values and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: triad masses 7, 23, 39; alkaline earth family with Sr and Ra; livermorium; balanced Mg + steam, Na₂O₂ and P₂O₃ + water equations; MgO(s); S in SCl₂ = +2; O first IE about 1314 kJ mol⁻¹; second EA of O = +798 kJ mol⁻¹. The printed P₂O₃ + NaOH equation and the oxygen 1365 value are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
